# vpsie_access_token (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vpsie_access_token" "example" {
  name            = "my-api-token"
  expiration_date = "2025-12-31"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expiration_date` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `status` (String) Whether the token is active. `1` for active, `0` for disabled. The API requires it; defaults to `1`.

### Read-Only

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) The token value. The API generates it and returns it only once, at creation; it is kept in the state and cannot be read back.
- `created_on` (String)
- `identifier` (String)
